content.text: Digital creators face significant challenges when conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable. COREMERCH provides a robust alternative, empowering you to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and more using a sovereign commerce infrastructure that relies solely on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|Crypto Payment]] payments. With our solutions, you can bypass high fees and regain control over your business.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms often impose high fees and restrictive policies, making them unfeasible for creators in many regions. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference means that with just 100 sales a month on a $97 product, you could retain an additional $921. This sovereign infrastructure provides a reliable and cost-effective means to transact, ensuring you maintain full ownership and control over your digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign commerce stack, gather all necessary digital assets, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and any other products you plan to sell. Ensure you have your crypto wallet set up for receiving payments. Familiarize yourself with the deployment components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Understanding each element will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, begin by deploying either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. With your chosen stack, configure NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Set up automated delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to ensure your products are delivered immediately upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees a seamless purchasing experience for your customers while ensuring you retain full control of your digital assets.
Retain more profit by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to go live. Start by testing your payment and delivery pipeline with a small transaction to ensure everything functions correctly. Once verified, promote your products through social media and relevant channels. Monitor your first transaction closely; if executed properly, this will set the tone for future sales. Remember to leverage your data ownership to analyze customer behavior and optimize your offerings.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. You can expand your product offerings or enhance your marketing strategies to reach a broader audience. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all six blueprints and seven templates, providing you with everything needed to build and scale your digital commerce stack efficiently. This will enable you to optimize your operations while maintaining control over your digital products.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate delivery to enhance customer experience.

For those looking for a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all blueprints and templates needed to deploy your digital commerce stack effectively.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital products and prepare them for sale. Set up your crypto wallet for payments. Choose between the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack for deployment. Configure NOWPayments for transaction processing. Implement automated delivery through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Launch your digital storefront and promote it through relevant channels. Monitor transactions and analyze customer data for insights.
